name: Willowbrook Surgery
strap: NHS GP services for Willowbrook and the surrounding villages
access: Free patient parking, including four accessible bays by the door
Step-free access throughout the ground floor
Hearing loop at reception — just ask
The number 12 bus stops directly outside
enhancedAccess: Evening and Saturday appointments (6:30pm to 8pm on weekdays, 9am to 5pm on Saturdays) run at our Primary Care Network's Enhanced Access hub at Riverside Health Centre, a short drive away. Book them the same way as any appointment — online, in the NHS App or by phone.
outOfHours: When the surgery is closed, contact NHS 111 online or by phone — they can arrange out-of-hours care and book urgent appointments where needed. In a life-threatening emergency, always call 999.

icb.name: NHS Willowbrook & District Integrated Care Board
icb.copy: The surgery provides NHS services under contract to NHS Willowbrook & District Integrated Care Board (a fictional ICB for this sample site), Wharf House, Riverside Park, Reading RG1 9YY. Telephone 0118 496 0900.
